caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate beer stein with a large, rounded body and a sturdy base. The stein is predominantly blue with metallic gray or silver accents and details. The handle is curved and decorated with a beaded pattern along its outer edge. On the main surface of the stein, there is a prominent raised relief of a standing figure dressed in period clothing, possibly a historical or mythological character, surrounded by decorative patterns and additional raised motifs. The background around the figure is filled in with a rich blue color, contrasting with the metallic gray of the relief work. The rim and the base are wide and metallic, and the upper part of the stein also shows layering and detailing. The composition is focused tightly on the stein, depicted against a neutral, off-white background. The artist’s name, “Carl Buergerniss,” is written in small letters on the lower right side of the image.
title: Beer Mug
